description_ar: أسئلة مباشرة حول الأنواع 0 و1 و2 و3 والمختلط و unless

questions.question_en: If it rains, we ___ at home.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: will stay. If + present simple → will + V1 (first conditional).
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: will stay. If + مضارع بسيط ← will + V1 (النوع الأول).
questions.memorization_note: النوع 1 (مستقبل ممكن): $\text{If} + \text{present simple}, \text{will} + V_1$ ، ولا نضع $\text{will}$ بعد $\text{if}$.

questions.question_en: If I ___ rich, I would travel the world.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: were. Second conditional: If + past simple (were).
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: were. النوع الثاني: If + ماضٍ بسيط (were).
questions.memorization_note: النوع 2 (خيالي في الحاضر): $\text{If} + \text{past simple}, \text{would} + V_1$ ، و $\text{If I were you}$ (were مع جميع الضمائر).

questions.question_en: If she had studied, she ___ the exam.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: would have passed. Third conditional: would have + V3.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: would have passed. النوع الثالث: would have + V3.
questions.memorization_note: النوع 3 (ندم على الماضي): $\text{If} + \text{had} + V_3, \text{would have} + V_3$

questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: melts. Zero conditional (fact): present simple.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: melts. النوع 0 (حقيقة) ← مضارع بسيط.

questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: were. 'If I were you' is the fixed advice form.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: were. التعبير الثابت If I were you.
questions.memorization_note: النوع 2 (خيالي في الحاضر): $\text{If} + \text{past simple}, \text{would} + V_1$ ، و $\text{If I were you}$ (were مع جميع الضمائر).

questions.question_en: We will go to the beach if the weather ___ good.
questions.question_ar: سنذهب إلى الشاطئ إذا ____ الطقس جيداً.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: is. No 'will' after if: present simple is.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: is. لا نضع will بعد if ← is.
questions.memorization_note: النوع 1 (مستقبل ممكن): $\text{If} + \text{present simple}, \text{will} + V_1$ ، ولا نضع $\text{will}$ بعد $\text{if}$.

questions.question_en: If he ___ earlier, he would have caught the bus.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: had left. Third conditional if-clause: had + V3.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: had left. جملة if في النوع الثالث: had + V3.
questions.memorization_note: النوع 3 (ندم على الماضي): $\text{If} + \text{had} + V_3, \text{would have} + V_3$

questions.question_en: Unless you hurry, you ___ the train.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: will miss. Unless = if not; result clause: will + V1.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: will miss. unless = if not والنتيجة will + V1.

questions.question_en: If I had known, I ___ you.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: would have told. Third conditional: would have + V3.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: would have told. النوع الثالث: would have + V3.
questions.memorization_note: النوع 3 (ندم على الماضي): $\text{If} + \text{had} + V_3, \text{would have} + V_3$

questions.question_en: What would you do if you ___ a million dollars?
questions.question_ar: ماذا كنت ستفعل لو ____ مليون دولار؟
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: won. Second conditional: if + past simple.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: won. النوع الثاني: if + ماضٍ بسيط.
questions.memorization_note: النوع 2 (خيالي في الحاضر): $\text{If} + \text{past simple}, \text{would} + V_1$ ، و $\text{If I were you}$ (were مع جميع الضمائر).

questions.question_en: If you ___ me tomorrow, I'll tell you everything.
questions.question_ar: إذا ____ بي غداً فسأخبرك بكل شيء.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: call. First conditional: present simple after if.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: call. النوع الأول: مضارع بسيط بعد if.
questions.memorization_note: النوع 1 (مستقبل ممكن): $\text{If} + \text{present simple}, \text{will} + V_1$ ، ولا نضع $\text{will}$ بعد $\text{if}$.

questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Unless. 'Unless' = if not, followed by a positive verb.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: Unless. Unless = if not ويليها فعل مثبت.

questions.question_en: If I hadn't been ill, I ___ to the party.
questions.question_ar: لو لم أكن مريضاً لكنت ____ إلى الحفلة.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: would have gone. Third conditional: would have + V3.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: would have gone. النوع الثالث: would have + V3.
questions.memorization_note: النوع 3 (ندم على الماضي): $\text{If} + \text{had} + V_3, \text{would have} + V_3$

questions.question_en: If he hadn't missed the flight, he ___ there now.
questions.question_ar: لو لم تفته الرحلة لكان ____ هناك الآن.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: would be. Mixed conditional: past condition, present result (now): would + V1.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: would be. مختلط: شرط ماضٍ ونتيجة حاضرة (now) ← would + V1.

questions.question_en: If you mix red and blue, you ___ purple.
questions.question_ar: إذا خلطت الأحمر والأزرق فإنك ____ البنفسجي.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: get. Zero conditional (general truth): present simple.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: get. النوع 0 (حقيقة عامة) ← مضارع بسيط.
